scr_rows_u16x36.meaning: threshold-matrix rows per slot (slot = method*9 + channel)

scr_rampstep_u8x36.meaning: step of the 256-entry linear ramp (partial-dot levels) per slot

scr_N_i32x36.meaning: divisor N: tone index -> (level-entry, remainder); 0 = slot unused

heat_mode_i32x5.meaning: heat-history mode per plane; 2 = process even/odd columns separately

heat_params_5x23.meaning: heat-history coefficients and shifts per plane (see spec)

heat_energy_shift_i32x5.meaning: shift after multiplying by load scale

heat_profile_shift_i32x5.meaning: shift after multiplying by column profile

round_4x4_u32.meaning: ordered-rounding thresholds for the final 12->8 bit step (index row=line&3, col=x&3)

lum_g_u16x256.meaning: luminance weight table for G (DIB byte 1)

lum_b_u16x256.meaning: luminance weight table for B (DIB byte 0)

lut_axis_u32x256.meaning: per input value: byte0 grid index, byte1 upper grid index (equal = on grid), byte2/byte3 interpolation fractions (0..15)

edge_count_u16.meaning: edge pattern length per distance-from-top/bottom line (disc outline)

edge_default_u8.meaning: default inner-edge value per plane (minus 10, floor 0)
